decisions.statement: A body is read as the runs of path characters that body holds.
A run is read again from each separator in that run.
The readings of one run are answered from the longest reading down.
A run with no separator is no path.
A run a `://` opens is no path.
A line with no separator holds no run.
A run is answered with the line that run sits on.
A run states whether a shell variable opens the path that run is part of.
A shell variable is a `$` before a name, with or without braces around it.
A `$` a path character sits before opens nothing.
A `$` before no name is no shell variable.
A line is numbered from one.
A run reaches over no line break.
Nothing here reads the language a body is written in.
Whether a run names a real path is not judged here.
Nothing here reads the disk or the index.

definition: the runs of path characters a body holds, each with the line that run sits on
